groups.note: SWEPT. Installed wall-plug electrical power for heating [MW] -- the entry point WI-039 minted. 100 and 220 MW are the predecessor study's 50 and 110 MW plasma-coupled levels restated at eta_pin_eff = 0.50, an exact mapping; arm-couple-110 additionally sweeps it as 110/eta_source (a scope extension recorded in study.py and the trail). NO TIE IS DECLARED, and that is the change: the heating account's installed power and the power balance's coupled power now descend from this one key through the chain, so the invariant the p_input/p_ecrh tie maintained holds structurally and the declaration was removed from manifest.json. Its constraint reach is the same three the retired p_input+tie had (F3) -- what is new is the chain between them.

SWEPT. Wall-plug to source-output conversion efficiency [1] -- gyrotron wall-plug efficiency. THIS AXIS DID NOT EXIST BEFORE THIS ROUND: the old lumped eta_pin was a held constant whose only appearance was a division inside the recirculating sum. Corrected after the pre-execution critique (F3): the ONE new reach in the whole comparison is eta_source_heat -> sustainment_ok, and it reaches that fence through the INSTALLED side of the inequality only. Its reachable objectives are identical to the old eta_pin's, and the oracle confirms p_fus, wall load, beta and p_aux_required are bit-identical across eta 0.40..0.60 at fixed (I, T, n) -- fusion performance does not respond to heating anywhere in this package. The wall-plug key's reach is NOT new: pre_wi039_indicators.json shows p_input+tie already reached sustainment_ok.

SWEPT, and the window reaches PAST 18 keV. Peak ion temperature; T_e0 rides the held 0.95 ratio inside the sustainment calc. 20260903-priced-levers#5 is the reason for the window: that study's optimum sat at the top of its swept window, so its temperature conclusion was window-edge-limited and could not be read as an optimum.

SWEPT. Peak electron density; the fuel peaks are computed from it by quasi-neutrality with the converged ash, and the line-averaged ISS04 density derives from it. Carried at the predecessor study's widened window, which was widened on critique so the range could actually reach the beta limit.

SWEPT. Peak single-coil current, the field lever; since WI-036 it also sizes the winding pack, so it reaches the conductor strain check as well as the structural one. Carried because the heating question cannot be read without the field fences that bound the same operating point.

DECLINED, traced. The source-output to plasma-coupled fraction -- the stated deposition assumption held at 1.00. Reason CORRECTED after the critique (F6): the first reason given (that sweeping an unmeasured assumption reads as knowledge the model does not have) was wrong -- a sensitivity to an assumption is how fragility is shown. The real reason is DEGENERACY: the two efficiencies enter the sustainment fence only as their product, so sweeping eta_source over 0.40..0.60 at eta_couple = 1.0 already delivers the entire eta_pin 0.40..0.60 fence sensitivity; the two differ only in the cost term, second-order here. WHAT TRAVELS WITH EVERY RESULT INSTEAD: 1.00 is the OPTIMISTIC end of the assumption, so every feasibility claim in this study is made at the most generous possible coupling.

DECLINED, traced. Plasma major radius with its declared magnet__R0 tie. Geometry belongs to this goal's WALL half and to round 2: R's effect on wall load at this pin is an open measurement, not a known (the pre-WI-037 'constant in R' result was measured with held fuel densities and does not transfer), and sweeping it here would confound the heating question with the wall question this round deliberately did not touch.

DECLINED, traced. Plasma minor radius. Same reason as R+tie: it is the wall half's lever, and the committed 20260829-p-pump-fence result that wall_load_ok is violated at every a >= 1.70 makes it the most confounding axis to add to a heating study.

DECLINED, traced. The conductor peak-field ceiling. It remains unpriced -- WI-036 priced the winding pack but gave the conductor GRADE no cost consequence, and WI-038 is its vehicle, sequenced after this goal's wall half and after WI-040. Sweeping it would manufacture feasible points that cost nothing.

DECLINED, traced, and CHECKED rather than assumed (critique F7). Winding-pack current density. The critique probed it across 95..145 A/mm^2 at the search arm's best point: a 53% swing moves LCOE by 0.08 $/MWh (0.03%) and moves B_peak, p_aux_required and wall load NOT AT ALL, including at a field-blocked current. So no conclusion in this study is a j_wp artifact -- this is not the predecessor's held-axis failure repeating. Its inertness is itself a model-development observation: WI-036 priced the winding pack and the current density still reaches almost no cost.
